cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I taught you to welcome people; he can have my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How observant—you are learning to host. Don't worry about me; these peas will keep my plate occupied.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very thoughtful. You can practise keeping a hungry host company. Leave my fork out; I'll need it forty minutes after everyone else has finished.

reason: Make the lesson B actual company for hungry A, not the impossible repetition of A hunger, and display the waiting cost through the fork request.
